questionDetail.sql:
SELECT SUM(total_price) AS total_facturado
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded' AND created_at_platform >= now() - interval '12 months'

SELECT SUM(total_price) AS total_revenue
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded' AND created_at_platform >= '2025-12-01' AND created_at_platform < '2026-01-01'

SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at_platform) AS month, 
       SUM(total_price) AS total_sales 
FROM v_orders 
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded' 
  AND created_at_platform >= now() - interval '1 year' 
GROUP BY month 
ORDER BY month 
LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(order_number) AS total_orders_last_month 
FROM v_orders 
WHERE created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month') 
AND created_at_platform < date_trunc('month', now()) 
AND financial_status <> 'refunded'

SELECT oi.product_ref, oi.title, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM v_order_items oi
JOIN v_orders o ON oi.order_number = o.order_number
WHERE o.financial_status <> 'refunded' AND o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY oi.product_ref, oi.title
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT oi.product_ref, p.title, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue
FROM v_order_items oi
JOIN v_products p ON oi.product_ref = p.product_ref
WHERE oi.financial_status <> 'refunded'
GROUP BY oi.product_ref, p.title
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT oi.product_ref, p.title, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM v_order_items oi
JOIN v_orders o ON oi.order_number = o.order_number
JOIN v_products p ON oi.product_ref = p.product_ref
WHERE o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('year', now()) AND o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
GROUP BY oi.product_ref, p.title
ORDER BY total_units_sold ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.product_type AS category, SUM(o.total_price) AS total_revenue
FROM v_orders o
JOIN v_order_items oi ON o.order_number = oi.order_number
JOIN v_products p ON oi.product_ref = p.product_ref
WHERE o.financial_status <> 'refunded'
AND o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY p.product_type
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
    date_trunc('quarter', created_at_platform) AS quarter, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS order_count, 
    SUM(total_price) AS total_revenue 
FROM 
    v_orders 
WHERE 
    financial_status <> 'refunded' 
    AND created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '6 months' 
GROUP BY 
    quarter 
ORDER BY 
    quarter DESC 
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
    SUM(total_price) AS total_sales_q4_2025 
FROM 
    v_orders 
WHERE 
    created_at_platform >= '2025-10-01' AND created_at_platform < '2026-01-01' AND financial_status <> 'refunded'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    SUM(total_price) AS total_sales_q1_2026 
FROM 
    v_orders 
WHERE 
    created_at_platform >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at_platform < '2026-04-01' AND financial_status <> 'refunded'

SELECT oi.product_ref, p.title, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold_last_2_months
FROM v_order_items oi
JOIN v_orders o ON oi.order_number = o.order_number
JOIN v_products p ON oi.product_ref = p.product_ref
WHERE o.financial_status <> 'refunded' 
AND o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '4 months') 
GROUP BY oi.product_ref, p.title
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_units_sold_last_2_months ASC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
    date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform) AS month,
    SUM(o.total_price) AS revenue_current_year,
    LAG(SUM(o.total_price)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform)) AS revenue_last_year
FROM 
    v_orders o
WHERE 
    o.financial_status <> 'refunded' 
    AND o.created_at_platform >= date_trunc('year', now()) - interval '1 year' 
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month
LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(customer_ref) AS recurrent_customers_count FROM v_customers WHERE orders_count >= 2

SELECT customer_ref, total_spent 
FROM v_customers 
ORDER BY total_spent DESC 
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN orders_count >= 2 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_repeat_customers
FROM v_customers

SELECT COUNT(customer_ref) AS new_customers_count
FROM v_customers
WHERE first_order_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '3 months'

SELECT customer_ref, orders_count, total_spent, first_order_at, last_order_at, city, province, country, tags 
FROM v_customers 
WHERE last_order_at < now() - interval '6 months' 
LIMIT 1000

SELECT AVG(total_price) AS average_order_value
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded'
AND created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT 
    date_trunc('month', o.created_at_platform) AS month, 
    AVG(o.total_price) AS average_order_value 
FROM 
    v_orders o 
WHERE 
    o.financial_status <> 'refunded' 
    AND o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '1 year' 
GROUP BY 
    month 
ORDER BY 
    month 
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN orders_count >= 2 THEN 'Repeat Customers' 
        ELSE 'First-Time Buyers' 
    END AS customer_type,
    AVG(total_price) AS average_order_value
FROM v_orders
JOIN v_customers ON v_orders.customer_ref = v_customers.customer_ref
WHERE v_orders.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days' 
    AND v_orders.financial_status <> 'refunded'
GROUP BY customer_type

SELECT product_ref, product_title, sku, quantity, location 
FROM v_inventory 
WHERE quantity = 0 
LIMIT 1000
SELECT product_ref, product_title, quantity, location FROM v_inventory WHERE quantity < 20 LIMIT 1000

SELECT location, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_in_stock
FROM v_inventory
GROUP BY location
LIMIT 1000

questionDetail.sql:
SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_price) AS total_revenue
FROM v_orders o
JOIN v_customers c ON o.customer_ref = c.customer_ref
WHERE o.financial_status <> 'refunded' AND o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.province, SUM(o.total_price) AS total_revenue
FROM v_orders o
JOIN v_customers c ON o.customer_ref = c.customer_ref
WHERE o.financial_status <> 'refunded' AND c.country = 'Spain'
AND o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY c.province
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1000

questionDetail.sql:
SELECT city, COUNT(o.order_number) AS orders_count
FROM v_orders o
JOIN v_customers c ON o.customer_ref = c.customer_ref
WHERE o.created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY orders_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS returned_orders_count
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status = 'refunded' AND created_at_platform >= date_trunc('year', now())

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN financial_status = 'refunded' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS refund_percentage
FROM v_orders

SELECT oi.product_ref, oi.title, COUNT(oi.order_number) AS return_count
FROM v_order_items oi
JOIN v_orders o ON oi.order_number = o.order_number
WHERE o.financial_status = 'refunded'
GROUP BY oi.product_ref, oi.title
ORDER BY return_count DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(total_discounts) AS total_discounts_last_quarter
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded' 
AND created_at_platform >= date_trunc('quarter', now() - interval '3 months') 
AND created_at_platform < date_trunc('quarter', now())

SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN total_discounts > 0 THEN total_price END) AS average_ticket_with_discount,
    AVG(CASE WHEN total_discounts = 0 THEN total_price END) AS average_ticket_without_discount
FROM v_orders
WHERE created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days' AND financial_status <> 'refunded'

SELECT source_name, SUM(total_price) AS total_sales
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded' AND created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY source_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT to_char(created_at_platform, 'Day') AS day_of_week, SUM(total_price) AS total_sales
FROM v_orders
WHERE financial_status <> 'refunded' AND created_at_platform >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(order_number) AS unfulfilled_orders_count FROM v_orders WHERE fulfillment_status <> 'fulfilled'
